assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Fixture insertion omits or duplicates stored runs; independent SQL count no longer equals 20000.
Composition errors, selects an unexpected plan, or instrumentation misses the known 50 review, 20000 run or 50 plan cold inputs.
An unchanged pass changes composition or reparses any input; restoring the base uncached run read or clearing reuse makes the parse assertions fail.
A rewritten review fails to invalidate only its cached parse, reparses other inputs, or changes the expected owed-review result.
A plan and run rewrite changes composition incorrectly, decodes zero or multiple run payloads, rereads reviews, or parses unrelated plans; base read yields 20000 instead of one.
The warm or cold cache path disagrees with fallback composition or the independent ledger-backed author selection; reference uses unchanged base policy helpers, not a supplied expected return.
Time expiry, clock reversal, a live author, a rewritten plan/session, or deletion yields a different author selection from the ledger reference, or a final unchanged selection decodes runs again.

gate_evidence.negative_control: Clearing file_memo at each composition pass produced 51 plan, 50 review and 20000 run parses; 2 failed in 4.21s; EXIT=1

item_verdicts.diff: Read the sole commit e505ca84ca4052f79ee70b75505dffcb0b936ab9 against d0b16d70143dda6140081fd63eaaeda728a0a699; it adds author-selection caching in reckon/crew/plan_review.py:4089 and two regression tests, plus one harmless formatting adjustment.
item_verdicts.done_when: Live docs/plans/history-persists-as-detail-washes-out.html:427 and source prompt.txt:175 require 50 plans, 20000 runs, zero warm parses, changed-input parsing, base parity and no added importing-test failures; the new tests and completed all_debug gate logs measure these requirements.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal in the source prompt.txt:38 is incremental owed-review parsing; reckon/crew/plan_review.py:4114 adds stored-author reuse while retaining the existing plan and review memoization.
item_verdicts.manifest: Source manifest.md names e505ca84ca4052f79ee70b75505dffcb0b936ab9 and readable baseline_suite and after_suite receipts corroborated by baseline-suite.log and after-suite.log, although its current status is in-progress while the source run is resumed.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Source prompt.txt:94 and manifest.md declare plan_review.py, resumption.py, the new test and optional evidence paths; the two-file diff stays within those declarations.

justifications.durability: tests/test_an_owed_review_pass_pays_for_what_changed.py:175 and :201 fail when reuse is removed and :232-261 compare expiry, clock reversal, live pointers, rewrite and deletion against the base-policy ledger reference, although archive invalidation and equal-stamp ordering lack dedicated cases.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_an_owed_review_pass_pays_for_what_changed.py:168 positively calibrates all counters before :175 asserts zero warm parses, and source final-base-reproduction.log and negative-control.log both record two failures while after-suite.log records 60 passes with EXIT=0.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:4089-4186 uses mechanism-based names, existing file_memo ownership and ledger timestamp/order helpers, and the source stream.jsonl records clean final scoped Ruff checks.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:4167 memoizes changed row payloads and :4182 memoizes selections by store and archive stamps and time bucket, satisfying zero warm parsing and incremental decode work.
justifications.reuse: Capability searches and owner reads found memoization in reckon/file_memo.py:445, joined encoded rows in reckon/run_store.py:330 and decoded activity selection in :650; the added helpers reuse those owners while supplying author-specific projection and parse-free selection that the existing decoded activity path at :451 cannot provide.
justifications.scope_discipline: The complete diff changes only reckon/crew/plan_review.py and tests/test_an_owed_review_pass_pays_for_what_changed.py, both explicitly declared in source prompt.txt:95-97.
